The outlined treatment plan for Alice's Type 2 diabetes is highly appropriate and aligns with standard clinical guidelines. The combination of lifestyle modifications—specifically a low glycemic index diet and regular moderate-intensity exercise—addresses the root causes of insulin resistance and helps manage weight. Daily blood sugar monitoring allows for better tracking of how these lifestyle changes and medication affect glucose levels. Metformin is widely considered the first-line pharmacological treatment for Type 2 diabetes due to its efficacy, safety profile, and ability to improve insulin sensitivity. Furthermore, scheduling follow-up appointments every three months is standard practice to assess HbA1c levels, adjust medications if necessary, and ensure the treatment plan remains effective.
